strategy_roster.name: Martingail Expert
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) and EMA(20) are explicit fallbacks for the undocumented Stochastic timing levels and trend confirmation. Geometric ladders, point spacing/targets, and loss-dependent volume cannot be represented in the stateless one-position simulator.

strategy_roster.name: iVIDyA Simple
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(12) is a static proxy for momentum-adaptive VIDYA, preserving its documented base period while dropping the CMO adaptation. The one-bar shift, 150/460-point protection, and intraday timeframe cannot be expressed.

strategy_roster.name: Bullish Abandoned Baby
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and close > donchian_high_prev(high,2) and close - low >= 0.5 * atr(high,low,close,14)
strategy_roster.notes: A full bullish candle breaking the prior two-bar high approximates the third-candle gap and doji reversal; the ATR body filter is a fallback. Exact three-candle gap/doji geometry and opposite-pattern handling are unavailable, while 2% is documented.

strategy_roster.name: Supertrend And MACD
strategy_roster.entry_long: ema(close,20) > ema(close,200) and close > ema(close,20) and macd(close,12,26) > macd_signal(close,12,26,9)
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(20/200) is an explicit SuperTrend direction proxy and MACD(12,26,9) retains the documented confirmation/exit. ATR(10) factor 3 and ten-bar highest/lowest trailing stops are not fixed percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: MACD Cross AUDUSD D1
strategy_roster.notes: The standard MACD(12,26,9) bullish cross and bearish exit are retained; the docs do not give indicator lengths. The 06:00-14:00 gate, 40-pip stop, and 3R pip target cannot be represented as fixed percentage exits.

strategy_roster.name: Maximus vX Lite
strategy_roster.notes: A 40-bar high break with ATR(14) below its 20-bar mean approximates the consolidation-zone breakout; lengths are fallbacks where the source defaults concern point offsets. Dynamic boxes, point targets, pyramiding, risk sizing, and profit lock are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Narrow Range
strategy_roster.entry_long: high - low < sma(high - low,4) and close > donchian_high_prev(high,4)
strategy_roster.notes: Current range below its four-bar mean approximates narrowness relative to the Length=4 reference, and a prior four-bar high break is the long trigger. The documented 0.35 stop applies to reference range rather than entry price, so it is not a fixed percentage field.

strategy_roster.name: Genie Pivot
strategy_roster.entry_long: roc(close,7) < 0 and low < donchian_low_prev(low,7) and close > open
strategy_roster.notes: Seven-bar negative momentum, a new seven-bar low, and a bullish close approximate the decreasing-lows Genie Pivot. Exact higher-low/prior-high structure, point target/trailing, and loss-based volume reduction are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Open Two Pending Orders
strategy_roster.notes: A close above the prior ten-bar high with average volume proxies the buy-stop leg; ten bars and volume threshold are fallbacks. Simultaneous pending orders, cancellation, margin sizing, and 100/300-point protection plus trailing are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Rock Trader Neuro
strategy_roster.notes: Below-average normalized Bollinger width below the middle band proxies a negative neuron output; Bollinger(20,2) and seven observations preserve its feature window. Fixed seven-neuron weights/tanh and 30/100-point protection are not DSL features.
